items.title: Sirpur Heritage Site enters UNESCO tentative list
items.snippet: Sirpur, the historic town on the banks of the Mahanadi in Chhattisgarh, has gained international recognition with its inclusion in UNESCO’s Tentative List. Known for its ancient temples, Buddhist monasteries and archaeological remains, the town reflects centuries of religious, artistic and cultural exchange.

items.title: IndiGo weighs fuel stabilisation fund participation
items.snippet: IndiGo CEO Pieter Elbers said the airline could participate in the Indian government’s proposed fuel price stabilisation fund, although no further details were provided. The move comes as elevated aviation fuel costs and currency depreciation continue to put pressure on the airline’s profitability. The airline also indicated that its long-term fleet expansion plans remain unchanged.

items.title: Ambuja Neotia to invest Rs 2,700 crore in West Bengal’s hospitality sector; strengthening partnership with IHCL
items.snippet: Indian Hotels Company Limited and Ambuja Neotia have launched AltAir House under the IHCL SeleQtions brand in Kolkata and Siliguri. The opening is part of a larger investment commitment of Rs 2,700 crore in West Bengal's hospitality sector. Each property is designed to reflect the local culture and offer unique dining experiences.

items.title: Accor promotes Tejus Jose to Vice President – Asset Management, India and South Asia
items.snippet: Accor has announced the promotion of Tejus Jose to Vice President – Asset Management, India and South Asia. In his new role, Jose will focus on strengthening hotel asset performance, enhancing owner relationships and driving strategic initiatives aimed at creating long-term value across the group’s regional portfolio.

items.title: Himachal government holds e-auction for Wildflower Hall Hotel, receives record bid of 47.1 per cent revenue
items.snippet: The Himachal Pradesh government held an e-auction for granting license rights for the operation and management of the prestigious Wildflower Hall Hotel in Shimla, which resulted in a record bid of 47.1% of the annual gross revenue, CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu said on Friday.

items.title: Hyatt and Saraca Hotels and Resorts announce plans for four hotels across North India
items.snippet: Hyatt Hotels Corporation has signed agreements with Saraca Hotels and Resorts to add four Hyatt-branded properties across Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. The collaboration will mark the entry of the Unscripted by Hyatt brand into India while expanding the group’s presence in the leisure and wildlife tourism markets of Lucknow and Jim Corbett.

items.title: Disney Cuts More Than 100 Jobs In Theme Park Division
items.snippet: Skift Take: CEO Josh D’Amaro has said he is highly focused on reducing costs at the media giant. The Walt Disney Company has laid off between 100 and 200 employees in its theme park division, according to a person familiar with the matter.

items.title: How CIVILIAN Hotel Uses Canary to Eliminate Lobby Lines in a Small Space
items.snippet: CIVILIAN Hotel's 203-room NYC boutique property reduced front desk congestion by deploying Canary's kiosk, mobile check-in, digital authorizations, and guest messaging tools.

items.title: World Cup, March Madness, Roland-Garros: when the hotel takes its place in the locker room
items.snippet: As partners of federations and tournaments, the major hotel groups are turning their properties into the backdrop of the sporting event. Hilton and Marriott film the pre-match ritual there, Accor redefines a palace hotel in the colours of a Grand Slam, and Hyatt records a podcast by women tennis players.
